# A package named like a local the generated code declares per call, such as
# result0 for the result of a nested call or idParsed for a parsed path
# parameter, is imported under an alias: otherwise the local declared before
# the handler spells the package's types would shadow the package.

muxt generate --use-receiver-type=Server
muxt check

exec go test -count=1

-- go.mod --
module example.com/app

go 1.24
-- result0/result0.go --
package result0

type Form struct {
	Name string `name:"name"`
}
-- idParsed/idParsed.go --
package idParsed

type Form struct {
	Name string `name:"name"`
}
-- templates.go --
package server

import (
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templatesFS embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templatesFS, "*"))
-- server.go --
package server

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"

	"example.com/app/idParsed"
	"example.com/app/result0"
)

type Server struct{}

func (Server) Count(context.Context) int { return 3 }

func (Server) Nested(n int, form result0.Form) string {
	return fmt.Sprintf("%d %s", n, form.Name)
}

func (Server) Parsed(id int, form idParsed.Form) string {
	return fmt.Sprintf("%d %s", id, form.Name)
}
-- index.gohtml --
{{define "POST /nested Nested(Count(ctx), form)"}}<form><input name="name"></form>{{.Result}}{{end}}
{{define "POST /parsed/{id} Parsed(id, form)"}}<form><input name="name"></form>{{.Result}}{{end}}
-- server_test.go --
package server

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"net/url"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func post(t *testing.T, mux *http.ServeMux, target string) string {
	t.Helper()
	request := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, target, strings.NewReader(url.Values{"name": {"gopher"}}.Encode()))
	request.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/x-www-form-urlencoded")
	recorder := httptest.NewRecorder()
	mux.ServeHTTP(recorder, request)
	return recorder.Body.String()
}

func Test(t *testing.T) {
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	TemplateRoutes(mux, Server{})
	if got := post(t, mux, "/nested"); !strings.Contains(got, "3 gopher") {
		t.Errorf("POST /nested = %q, want it to contain %q", got, "3 gopher")
	}
	if got := post(t, mux, "/parsed/7"); !strings.Contains(got, "7 gopher") {
		t.Errorf("POST /parsed/7 = %q, want it to contain %q", got, "7 gopher")
	}
}
